description: The bar chart illustrates execution accuracy results for two methods, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four difficulty categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories “Simple,” “Moderate,” “Challenging,” and “Total,” shown left to right, and the vertical axis is labeled “Execution Accuracy” with a linear numeric scale marked from 20 to 60 in increments of 10. Each category displays a grouped pair of vertical bars: NatSQL is shown in a lighter gray-blue color and TA-SQL in a darker blue color, with numeric value labels above each bar. For “Simple,” the NatSQL bar is labeled 60.21 and the TA-SQL bar 63.14; for “Moderate,” NatSQL is 39.64 and TA-SQL is 48.60; for “Challenging,” NatSQL is 32.32 and TA-SQL is 36.11; and for “Total,” NatSQL is 51.35 and TA-SQL is 56.19. The bars are not stacked, and there is a legend near the top identifying the two series; no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the value annotations.
